title: Shinonome Akito — Post-Competition Feast〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: What do you think? I tried seasoning and breading them a little differently this time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is good...
But I asked for fish today, since you've been pandering to Akito lately by making all those meat dishes for him.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. They were having a sale, so I couldn't help myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Another meat dish tomorrow would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's where you and your father are so alike. When we were younger, he did quite a lot of manual labor, so he always asked me to make him these hearty meals.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Come to think of it, his agility and dexterity were also very good. We went camping for one of our dates, and he caught a fish with his bare hands.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I managed to corner it, which made it easier to catch.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And he did that during a date?
Was that actually any fun for you, Mom?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, neither of you would be sitting here right now if I didn't enjoy being around him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Think you can still move like that?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Depends... But that obstacle course you said you did is likely beyond me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that thing was designed to be stupid hard...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, I heard that they made it a lot easier after the event so that kids could play on it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A couple people have been bugging me to take them, so I guess we can all go check it out.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow, cool!
It's really that obstacle course!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's also my first time here. This area's quite spacious, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I will in a second.
I'm not as athletic as all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They look like elementary schoolers.
How are they able to maintain their balance on those thin planks above the water...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That looks like fun!
Let's go over there first, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know that Toya doesn't like heights and Kohane isn't all that athletic, but that bridge shouldn't be much of a problem for them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's go with Len's suggestion.
We'll try crossing the wobbly bridge.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It felt like we flew across the water just now!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm glad you both enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's okay to put away your phone if you need to free up your hand, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just follow the advice Akito gave you a second ago, Toya. It should be easy to maintain your balance as long as you jump from the center of the plank.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I did it! I made it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nice...!
You just gotta jump once more to get to this side.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm next!
Ready, Luka, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow! Th-That was so cool.
You were as light as a feather...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Join me, Kohane!
Don't worry! I'll make sure to catch you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, lemme put my phone away first...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, she jumped way before the end!
She might just barely make it to the other plank...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no! I threw it up into the air by accident!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <No fair! I wanna do that too!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way!
Toya, hold my phone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A little more to the left! But I'm running out of space to stand...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it!
Luka, KAITO, are you still with us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Luka, KAITO!
I didn't mean to...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, it was my fault for throwing my phone into the air...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It's okay!
As startling as that was, it ended up being quite thrilling♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <To be fair, even if we did fall we would just return to SEKAI. There was no actual risk of us getting hurt.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure shouted “Help us!!!” loud enough, for people who weren't in any danger.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anyone else were here, they'd also have heard you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Still, Akito, that was a magnificent save! Your training has really done wonders for you.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't believe how quickly you were able to cross that plank and catch her phone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Akito!
I promise to pay you back sometime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's no big deal.
But some juice might be nice.
